bootstrap.rule: within each TR0 stratum, its sequences drawn with replacement, as many as it holds; strata in order, units sorted, one draw per stratum per resample; a merged reporting stratum uses the union of its members' draws; pooled weights from the resample's own pair counts; the pooled interval is undefined if any full-data-defined reporting stratum is undefined on some resample (counted, never dropped)

pilot_bootstrap.design: the 300 pilot sequences resampled with replacement within their length strata; the ranking rebuilt from the recorded witnesses

radius_vs_gap.disagreement_definition: lowest quartile of one, upper half of the other

stability.pool: TS0 MFE pairs with p >= 0.99; certified = registration 1's label at lambda = 1; 'all three' = kept under every whole table
